candidate_execution.current-static-control: A deterministic mirror of the current bpm-docs-search.js lexical scoring core. Browser rendering remains an M3-04 integration measurement.
candidate_execution.pagefind-1.5.2: Real Pagefind 1.5.2 CLI index and Search API query against a temporary same-origin localhost static site; fetch is guarded to that origin.
candidate_execution.meilisearch-ce-1.45.1: Real Meilisearch Community Edition 1.45.1 process bound to temporary loopback only; the benchmark client is not a browser and all HTTP calls are guarded to its private origin.

metrics.top_1: Correct expected topic at rank one among expected-topic queries.
metrics.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank using the first five returned topics among expected-topic queries.
metrics.recall_at_5: Expected topic occurs in the first five returned topics among expected-topic queries.
metrics.no_result_precision: Correct empty responses divided by all empty responses among scored expected-topic and expected-no-result queries.
metrics.no_result_recall: Correct empty responses divided by expected-no-result queries.

output.raw_format: newline-delimited JSON; one record per candidate and query
output.summary_format: deterministic JSON with candidate and per-locale metrics
output.selection_boundary: A relevance result alone does not select a candidate; M3-04 and M3-05 remain required.
